UI_AIM_PROMPT: Tap an enemy room to aim
UI_MOVE_PROMPT: Tap a room to send them there
UI_HINT: Tap a weapon, then an enemy room. Tap crew, then a room. Tap a system to add power, hold to remove.
EV_LANTERN_BUOY: A drift-lantern still burns at the edge of the lane, a little Light caught in its glass. Nobody has tended it in years.
EV_LANTERN_BUOY_C1_O1: The glass goes dark and the Ember drinks it in.
EV_LANTERN_BUOY_C1_O2: The Ember drinks, and far behind you something in the dark turns to look.
EV_LANTERN_BUOY_C2: Leave it burning for whoever comes next.
EV_LANTERN_BUOY_C2_O1: You pass it by. The lantern keeps its small vigil.
EV_ASH_TOLL: An Ashmarket toll-skiff swings across your bow. Its captain wants ten scrap for the privilege of the lane.
EV_ASH_TOLL_C2: Have the Kith slip them a forged ledger.
EV_ASH_TOLL_C2_O1: Three small voices argue the captain into a refund.
EV_ASH_TOLL_C3_O1: The skiff signals its friends. A cutter drops out of the dark.
EV_FROZEN_HAULER: A hauler drifts with its engines dead. Through the frost on its viewports you can see its crew, still at their posts.
EV_FROZEN_HAULER_C1: Spend Light to thaw the bridge.
EV_FROZEN_HAULER_C1_O1: Two of them wake. They press scrap into your hands and won't stop thanking you.
EV_FROZEN_HAULER_C1_O2: They wake wrong, quiet and teal at the edges. Your crew fight them off.
EV_FROZEN_HAULER_C2_O1: You take what you can carry and don't look at the viewports.
EV_TIDEWARDEN_PATROL: A Tidewarden patrol hails you. They keep the lanes lit, and they want to see what you are carrying.
EV_TIDEWARDEN_PATROL_C1_O1: They bow to it, take a tithe of Light, and patch your hull before they go.
EV_TIDEWARDEN_PATROL_C2: Run dark until they lose you.
EV_TIDEWARDEN_PATROL_C2_O1: You slip past with your lights off. Something scrapes the hull in the dark.
EV_CHOIR_SIGNAL: Every channel fills with the same slow hymn. The Hollow Choir is singing, and the song is for you.
EV_CHOIR_SIGNAL_C1_O1: The song ends in a gift: the Ember brightens.
EV_CHOIR_SIGNAL_C1_O2: The song gets into the crew's heads. It takes hours to shake.
EV_CHOIR_SIGNAL_C2: Have the Sable answer in kind.
EV_CHOIR_SIGNAL_C2_O1: The Sable sing back. The Choir goes quiet, then sends coordinates and a little Light.
EV_DEBRIS_FIELD: A wreck field fills the lane, slow-turning hulls and loose plating everywhere.
EV_DEBRIS_FIELD_C1: Thread through and grab what you can.
EV_DEBRIS_FIELD_C1_O2: A spinning plate catches the hull on the way out.
EV_DEBRIS_FIELD_C2_O1: It costs you time. Behind you, the dark gets closer.
EV_COLD_EMBER: You find a tiny ember on a dead beacon, almost out. It might take, if you feed it.
EV_COLD_EMBER_C1_O1: It catches and burns bright. You bring it aboard.
EV_COLD_EMBER_C1_O2: It gutters and goes out. The Light is gone.
EV_SALVAGE_DISPUTE: Two salvage crews are fighting over a fat wreck. The smaller one is losing, and begging for help.
EV_SALVAGE_DISPUTE_C1_O1: You turn your guns on the cutter. The salvagers promise a share if you win.
EV_SALVAGE_DISPUTE_C2_O1: You leave them to it. The comms go quiet behind you.
EV_QUIET_STATION: An old weather station, abandoned and still warm. Its heaters run on some forgotten timer.
EV_QUIET_STATION_C1_O1: A few warm hours. Everyone wakes up better.
EV_QUIET_STATION_C2_O1: Spare plating and a crate of rivets.
EV_HUSH_POCKET: A pocket of teal stillness sits across the lane. Sound dies in it. So does warmth.
EV_HUSH_POCKET_C1_O1: The Ember flares and the stillness parts around you.
EV_HUSH_POCKET_C2_O1: The cold gets into the hull. Frost cracks the plating.
UI_DEPTH_NONE: No extra rules. The Hush as you first met it.
UI_DEPTH_STACKS: Every rule above this depth applies too.
UI_LOG_STATS: Runs %d   Wins %d   Best Gates %d   Deepest win %s
DEPTH_4_TEXT: Stores charge 1 more scrap for everything.
DEPTH_8_TEXT: The Hush moves faster still, and enemies have 2 more hull.
UI_REACH_NEXT: Ahead lies %s. The Hush has lost your trail, for now.
UI_RUN_WON: The last Gate falls behind you and the Ember still burns. The cold will have to wait.
UI_REFIT_TEXT: The dock crew raise a system a level for scrap. Burn Light in the Ember and the reactor runs hotter for good.
UI_REACH_DONE: You reach the Gate with the Ember still burning.
UI_HUSH_HIT: The Hush catches you. The hull freezes and cracks.
UI_DARK_JUMP: No Light left. You jump dark and the hull takes it.
UI_STORE_TEXT: The price board is up. Hull plate, bottled Light and salvaged gear, paid for in scrap. They buy gear back too.
UI_CONFIRM_ABANDON: Abandon this run? It can't be continued.
UI_CONFIRM_NEW_RUN: Start a new run? Your saved run will be lost.
UI_CONFIRM_TRAINING: Fly the training lane? Your saved run will be lost.
EV_CHAFF_AMBUSH: You drop out of the jump into a cloud of chaff. When it clears, a raider is already sitting on your tail with its guns warm.
EV_CHAFF_AMBUSH_C1_O1: You bring the ship about. They wanted a chase. They get a fight.
EV_CHAFF_AMBUSH_C2_O1: They stop to sweep up the scrap. You are two beacons gone before they look up.
EV_CHAFF_AMBUSH_C2_O2: They scoop up the scrap and keep coming.
EV_FALSE_DISTRESS: A distress call pulls you to a cracked hauler. The damage is real. The crew waiting in its shadow with their reactors cold are not in any distress at all.
EV_FALSE_DISTRESS_C1_O1: Your first volley lands while their wards are still dark.
EV_FALSE_DISTRESS_C2_O1: They let you go, with a parting shot to remember them by.
EV_FALSE_DISTRESS_C2_O2: You make it three ship-lengths before they light up and come after you.
EV_BUOY_TOLL: A string of Ashmarket buoys blinks across the lane: PAY AT THE MARKER. A cutter idles by the last buoy, waiting to see what you do.
EV_BUOY_TOLL_C1_O1: You burn past the marker. The cutter was hoping you would.
EV_BUOY_TOLL_C2_O1: Ten scrap into the drop-box. The cutter's lamp flicks green and you pass.
EV_BUOY_TOLL_C3: Have the Kith reprogram the buoys.
EV_BUOY_TOLL_C3_O1: The buoys start blinking DEBT COLLECTED at the cutter. It leaves, baffled.
EV_BUOY_TOLL_C3_O2: The trick buys you one clean shot before they work it out.
EV_DARK_BEACON: Someone has smashed the lamps on this beacon. A raider sits in the dark, waiting for ships to come in blind. You just came in blind.
EV_DARK_BEACON_C1_O1: The Ember flares and lights them up. They were not ready to be seen.
EV_DARK_BEACON_C2_O1: You trade shots blind. They find you first.
EV_FLEEING_RAIDER: A raider tears out of the jump behind you, running hard. Behind it the stars are going out one by one. It sees you and decides you are easier prey than whatever it is running from.
EV_FLEEING_RAIDER_C1_O1: You plant yourself in the lane. It turns its guns on you.
EV_FLEEING_RAIDER_C2_O1: You both burn hard across the beacon. It gives up first, but the Hush gained on you while you ran.
EV_BAIT_WRECK: A fat wreck hangs at the beacon with its holds still sealed. It is too easy, and the raider hiding behind it knows you will look anyway.
EV_BAIT_WRECK_C1_O1: You crack one hold before they jump you. Win, and the rest is yours.
EV_BAIT_WRECK_C2_O1: You take the long way around the wreck. A raider slides out from behind it and watches you go.
EV_BAIT_WRECK_C2_O2: You turn away, but they aren't letting a ship this warm leave.
EV_WARDEN_DESERTERS: A ship in Tidewarden colors hails you, then strikes its colors. Deserters. They want the Ember, and they were trained to take one.
EV_WARDEN_DESERTERS_C1_O1: They fight like wardens. You will have to fight better.
EV_WARDEN_DESERTERS_C2: Have the Sable sing the warden's oath.
EV_WARDEN_DESERTERS_C2_O1: The comms go quiet. Someone over there is crying. They let you pass.
EV_WARDEN_DESERTERS_C2_O2: They laugh at the oath and open fire.
EV_HEAT_HUNTERS: Hunters out of the Ashmarket have been following your heat for three jumps. Here they finally close in, and their captain offers terms: your scrap, or your hull.
EV_HEAT_HUNTERS_C1_O1: The captain sighs and signals the guns.
EV_HEAT_HUNTERS_C2_O1: They count it twice and peel away.
EV_ICED_DOCK: The beacon is crusted in ice. As you clamp on to clear it, the ice splits open. A raider has been sitting inside it, cold and quiet, waiting for someone to stop.
EV_ICED_DOCK_C1_O1: You tear free, leaving paint and plating on the clamp.
EV_ICED_DOCK_C2: Have the Oru hold the clamp shut.
EV_ICED_DOCK_C2_O1: The Oru hold the clamp while your guns find their hull at point blank.
EV_LANTERN_RAID: You arrive in the middle of a raid. A raider is cutting the Light out of a tended lantern while its keeper shouts at it over open comms.
EV_LANTERN_RAID_C1_O1: The keeper swears on the lantern that you will be paid if you win.
EV_LANTERN_RAID_C2_O1: You hold off until the raider has gone. The keeper's voice follows you across the beacon, and the wait costs you ground.
EV_DECOY_SCREEN: Your scope shows a ship exactly like yours: same hull, same heat. Then the image shivers, and an Ashmarket raider wearing a decoy screen fires at where it guessed you would be.
EV_DECOY_SCREEN_C1_O1: It guessed wrong. Now you know where it is.
EV_DECOY_SCREEN_C2: Break its lock with a flare of Light.
EV_DECOY_SCREEN_C2_O1: The Ember flares, the raider's screen fills with glare, and it loses you.
EV_CLAIM_JUMPERS: A Drifter salvage claim is pinned to this beacon. The raider guarding it says the claim is theirs now, and so is anything that stops here.
EV_CLAIM_JUMPERS_C1_O1: Win this and the claim, and its salvage, is yours.
EV_CLAIM_JUMPERS_C2: Have the Drifter read the claim aloud.
EV_CLAIM_JUMPERS_C2_O1: The claim names a Drifter clan the raider is afraid of. They leave in a hurry, and the salvage is yours.
EV_CLAIM_JUMPERS_C3_O1: They fire a warning shot as you go. It is not quite a warning.
EV_LIT_POST: A Tallow trading post hangs in the lane with every lamp lit, bright enough to see from three beacons out. A dockhand waves you in.
EV_LIT_POST_C1_O1: The dockhand clamps you on and turns over the price board.
EV_LIT_POST_C2_O1: You keep your distance. Bright places draw the Hush.
EV_DRIFTER_BARGE: A Drifter repair barge is anchored at the beacon, half its crew asleep in the hull plating. They will trade, if you can wake somebody.
EV_DRIFTER_BARGE_C1_O1: A Drifter yawns over the comms and names a price.
EV_DRIFTER_BARGE_C2: Have your Drifter ask for kin rates.
EV_DRIFTER_BARGE_C2_O1: Kin rates, it turns out, start with a small gift.
EV_DRIFTER_BARGE_C3_O1: You leave the barge snoring at its anchor.
EV_CHAINED_BAZAAR: An Ashmarket bazaar is chained to a dead station, ships tied up three deep. Everything here is for sale, including word of where you are going.
EV_CHAINED_BAZAAR_C1_O1: You keep your head down and a hand on your scrap.
EV_CHAINED_BAZAAR_C2_O1: They pay for coordinates that lead nowhere, then open the stalls.
EV_CHAINED_BAZAAR_C2_O2: Someone checks your coordinates before you leave the dock.
EV_CHAINED_BAZAAR_C3_O1: You cast off before anyone gets a good look at the Ember.
EV_WARDEN_DEPOT: A Tidewarden supply depot keeps its lamps low and its prices fair. The warden at the dock wants to see that you have kept your Ember fed.
EV_WARDEN_DEPOT_C1_O1: The warden nods at the Ember and unlocks the stores.
EV_WARDEN_DEPOT_C2_O1: The wardens patch a crack in your hull for the tithe, then open the stores.
EV_OLD_ORU_SHOP: A one-room shop drifts on the beacon. Its keeper, an old Oru, has outlived three Reaches and does not hurry for anybody.
EV_OLD_ORU_SHOP_C2: Have your Oru speak the slow greeting.
EV_OLD_ORU_SHOP_C2_O1: The old Oru brews something hot for your crew before any talk of prices.
EV_OLD_ORU_SHOP_C3_O1: You leave the old Oru to their long afternoon.
EV_EDGE_MARKET: A trading post sits right at the edge of the Hush, prices chalked high on its hull. The traders keep looking past you at the dark.
EV_EDGE_MARKET_C1_O1: They take your scrap fast and don't make small talk.
EV_EDGE_MARKET_C2_O1: You jump before the traders' nerves become yours.
EV_TICKING_BEACON: Nothing here but the beacon, ticking out its old signal to nobody. The crew take a breath.
EV_TICKING_BEACON_C1_O1: The crew rest. The dark creeps a little closer while they do.
EV_TUMBLING_CRATE: A cargo crate tumbles slowly across your bow, its seal unbroken.
EV_TUMBLING_CRATE_C1_O2: It was rigged. A small charge pops against the hull.
EV_TUMBLING_CRATE_C2_O1: The crate tumbles on into the dark.
EV_LIST_OF_NAMES: The beacon is carrying a message from a ship that passed years ago: a list of names, and the words WE KEPT IT LIT.
EV_LIST_OF_NAMES_C1_O1: Your crew read their names into the beacon. Nobody says much for a while, but they stand a little straighter.
EV_LIST_OF_NAMES_C2_O1: You leave the names to their signal.
EV_DEAD_STAR: This beacon circles a dead star. It went out long before the Hush came. The crew go quiet looking at it.
EV_DEAD_STAR_C1: Search the core for anything left.
EV_DEAD_STAR_C1_O1: One last warm grain in the core. The Ember takes it gratefully.
EV_DEAD_STAR_C1_O2: Nothing but cold, and time lost looking.
EV_DEAD_STAR_C2_O1: You leave the star to its long sleep.
EV_VENT_KITH: Something has been eating the ration packs. In a vent you find three young Kith who swear their ship left without them.
EV_VENT_KITH_C1: Give them a lamp of Light to get home.
EV_VENT_KITH_C1_O1: An hour later they hail you from a drifting hulk with a crate their ship left behind. They insist you take it.
EV_VENT_KITH_C2: Put them off at the beacon.
EV_VENT_KITH_C2_O1: You leave them a ration pack and a hand lamp. It's more than most would.
EV_UNLISTED_BEACON: Your jump lands you somewhere no chart lists. Every instrument agrees on the beacon, and on nothing else.
EV_UNLISTED_BEACON_C1_O1: The readings make no sense. You file them for someone smarter.
EV_UNLISTED_BEACON_C1_O2: The readings show a fold in the lane. You gain a little ground on the Hush.
EV_UNLISTED_BEACON_C2_O1: You don't wait to find out where you are.
UI_ROSTER_HINT: Tap a crew's post to change it
TUT_JUMP: Training flight. Tap a lit beacon to jump there. Each jump burns 1 Light.
TUT_CHOOSE: Every beacon has a story. Pick what you do.
TUT_AIM: Time is stopped. Tap your Rivet Gun.
TUT_AIM_ROOM: Now tap their weapons room to aim at it.
TUT_PLAY: Tap play. Time runs and your gun charges.
TUT_PAUSE: Tap pause any time to stop and think. Orders work while paused.
TUT_CREW: Crew at a station make it work better. Tap one of your crew.
TUT_CREW_ROOM: Now tap a room on your ship to send them there.
TUT_POWER_DOWN: Systems run on power. Hold Mend to take its power away.
TUT_POWER_UP: Tap Mend to give the power back.
TUT_WARD: Your ward covers one deck. Tap here to swap decks.
TUT_WIN: Tap play and win the fight. Pause whenever you need.
TUT_HUSH: The teal Hush swallows the chart behind you. Keep moving.
TUT_STORE: Tap something to see what it does, tap it again to buy. Leave when you are done.
TUT_DONE: Training done. Real Reaches are longer and the Hush is faster.
TUT_LOST: The Ember went out. Every run starts fresh. Try again.
TIP_FIRE: Fire spreads. Send crew into the room to put it out.
TIP_WARD_BLOCK: Their ward blocked that. Rivets strip ward layers, torches can't.
TIP_COLD: Rooms cool without the Ember. Cold crew work slowly.
TIP_LOW_HULL: Hull is low. Stores repair it for Scrap.
TIP_DARK_JUMP: Out of Light: jumping dark damages the hull.
SHIP_TALLOW_WREN_BLURB: A patched salvage tug. Steady hull, a torch and a rivet gun, a crew of four who know every leak.
SHIP_BRINE_CATHEDRAL_BLURB: A walled pilgrim hauler. Its guns and a heavy ward sit low behind thick plate, but the Ember is out on the top deck. Slow to dodge, slow to kill. Outlast them.
SHIP_PORCELAIN_SAINT_BLURB: Fast, armoured, crewed by Sable who carry their own heat. Torches only, and torches can't break a ward: burn the deck they leave open. No mend bay.
TUT_MUSTER: Crew work better at their post. Tap Muster to send everyone back.
TIP_POST: Hold a crew member to make that room their post.
UI_WARES_TEXT: A trader's spread of salvage. Gear fits a free slot, or goes in the hold.
UI_MODULES_TEXT: Modules. Tap one to see it, tap again to move it between its slot and the hold.
UI_GUNS_TEXT: Guns. Tap one to see it, tap again to move it between its mount and the hold.
UI_SELL_TEXT: Selling. Tap gear to see its price, tap again to sell it. You keep your last gun.
UI_UPKEEP_UNPAID: No Light for your modules. They drew on the dark, and the Hush came closer.
EV_RIME_RACK: A gun rack drifts free of a wreck, frost thick on its clamps. Something still hums inside it.
EV_RIME_RACK_C1_O1: The clamps give. You haul in a working gun, cold to the touch.
EV_RIME_RACK_C1_O2: The rack was bait. An Ashmarket boat slides out of the wreck's shadow.
EV_RIME_RACK_C2_O1: The rack tumbles away behind you.
EV_KILN_WRECK: A kiln barge sits dead in the dark, its coils still faintly warm.
EV_KILN_WRECK_C1: Spend Light to wake the coils
EV_KILN_WRECK_C1_O1: The coils glow and come loose in your hands. They will keep a deck warm.
EV_KILN_WRECK_C2_O1: You cut away what plating you can.
EV_TINKER_BARGE: A tinker's barge hails you. Its owner swaps odd parts for scrap, no questions asked.
EV_TINKER_BARGE_C1_O1: The tinker hands over a part in oiled cloth.
EV_TINKER_BARGE_C2_O1: They talk gears for an hour. The tinker gives you a part for the company.
REP_UP_TIDEWARDEN: The Tidewardens think better of you.
REP_UP_ASHMARKET: The Ashmarket calls you good for business.
REP_UP_CHOIR: Somewhere, the Hollow Choir sings your name.
REP_DOWN_CHOIR: The Hollow Choir goes quiet when you pass.
UI_REP_PRICE_UP: Prices here are %d scrap higher for you.
UI_REP_PRICE_DOWN: Prices here are %d scrap lower for you.
EV_WARDEN_DEPOT_C3: Call in a favor with the wardens.
EV_WARDEN_DEPOT_C3_O1: The warden waves your crew through and has the dock team weld your worst cracks for nothing.
EV_HEAT_HUNTERS_C3: Name your friends in the Ashmarket.
EV_HEAT_HUNTERS_C3_O1: The captain checks the names, swears, and wishes you a good lane.
EV_RIVAL_FIRST: A battered tug cuts across your lane and clamps onto the wreck you were heading for. Its captain, Ines Gall, waves at you through the glass. First clamp wins, she says.
EV_RIVAL_FIRST_C1: Race her for the best plate.
EV_RIVAL_FIRST_C1_O1: You swing in under her tug-arm and strip the best plate first. Gall goes very calm on the comms. She will remember this.
EV_RIVAL_FIRST_C1_O2: She clips you off the wreck with her tug-arm and takes the lot. You leave with a dent and a few scraps, and she leaves laughing.
EV_RIVAL_FIRST_C2_O1: Gall laughs and takes the stern half. She says she owes you one, and sounds like she means it.
EV_RIVAL_FIRST_C3_O1: Gall salutes as you pull away. It is hard to tell if she is mocking you.
EV_RIVAL_AMBUSH: The Low Wick drops out of the jump beside you. Ines Gall has brought friends: an Ashmarket gun-ship, paid for with the plate you took from her.
EV_RIVAL_AMBUSH_C1_O1: Gall hangs back and lets the gun-ship do the work. Win, and she will have to find new friends.
EV_RIVAL_AMBUSH_C2_O1: Gall counts it, calls it square, and sends the gun-ship home unpaid. It is not pleased.
EV_RIVAL_AID: Ines Gall hails you from a drifting dock with a hold full of spare plate and bottled Light. She has not forgotten the wreck you shared.
EV_RIVAL_AID_C1_O1: Her crew weld it on while Gall tells you which lanes have gone dark.
EV_RIVAL_AID_C2_O1: Two bottles of Light, still warm. Gall says to spend it before the Hush smells it.
EV_RIVAL_LAST: The Low Wick hangs dead at the beacon, frost on every port, and the Hush is lapping at her stern. Ines Gall is still aboard, breathing slow.
EV_RIVAL_LAST_C1_O1: Her Ember catches. Gall wakes, swears at you, and thanks you in the same breath. The Tidewardens hear of it.
EV_RIVAL_LAST_C2: Rig a tow and haul her clear.
EV_RIVAL_LAST_C2_O1: The tow holds. You drag her out of the teal, and she wakes up holding a chart of a short way through.
EV_RIVAL_LAST_C2_O2: The tow snaps twice before it holds. You get her out, but the Hush gets close, and so does a lot of ice.
EV_RIVAL_LAST_C3_O1: You jump. Nobody on the bridge says anything for a long time.
EV_CANTOR_FIRST: A voice speaks through the Ember itself, not the comms. It calls itself the Cantor of the Hollow Choir, and it asks what you mean to do with that fire.
EV_CANTOR_FIRST_C1: Tell it the truth: keep it lit.
EV_CANTOR_FIRST_C1_O1: The Cantor hums, pleased or amused. It says it will listen for you.
EV_CANTOR_FIRST_C2: Have your stoker sing back to it.
EV_CANTOR_FIRST_C2_O1: Your stoker finds the note. The Ember swells with the Cantor's answer, and the Choir takes notice.
EV_CANTOR_FIRST_C2_O2: The note cracks. The Cantor's voice turns sharp and cold, and the crew hear it in their teeth for hours.
EV_CANTOR_FIRST_C3: Bank the Ember until it goes.
EV_CANTOR_FIRST_C3_O1: The Ember dims and the voice fades. You have the feeling you were rude to something very old.
EV_CANTOR_HYMN: The Cantor speaks through the Ember again. Sing a little of your Light into the Choir's hymn, it offers, and the hymn will cover your wake.
EV_CANTOR_HYMN_C1: Give two Light to the hymn.
EV_CANTOR_HYMN_C1_O1: The Ember dims, and the dark behind you forgets which way you went.
EV_CANTOR_HYMN_C2_O1: The Cantor says nothing, which says enough.
EV_CANTOR_TRUTH: The Cantor speaks one last time. The Choir does not sing to the Hush, it says. It sings over it, the way you hum walking past a grave. It asks you to sing too, at the end.
EV_CANTOR_TRUTH_C1_O1: Something in the Ember answers before you do. The crew feel warmer than they have in days.
EV_CANTOR_TRUTH_C2_O1: The Cantor says it understands. It sounds like it has heard that before.
EV_WARDEN_ESCORT: A Tidewarden lamp-ship falls in beside you, and its warden knows your name. She offers to run your wake dark for a jump, so the Hush loses the scent.
EV_WARDEN_ESCORT_C1_O1: For a whole jump the dark behind you is quiet. When she peels off, the Hush is further back than it was.
EV_WARDEN_ESCORT_C2_O1: She sighs, and has her crew patch you from their own stores.
EV_WARDEN_BOUNTY: A Tidewarden bounty is posted on the beacon, for an Ashmarket raider that has been cutting lanterns. The raider is sitting right there, cutting one.
EV_WARDEN_BOUNTY_C1_O1: The wardens will pay well for this one, if you win.
EV_WARDEN_BOUNTY_C2_O1: The raider watches you go and gets back to its cutting.
EV_WARDEN_INSPECTION: Tidewarden cutters box you in. Word about you has reached them, and they want to board and search every deck.
EV_WARDEN_INSPECTION_C1_O1: They take their time, and leave bruises along with a stamped pass.
EV_WARDEN_INSPECTION_C2_O1: The fine is paid and logged. The cutters let you go, a little friendlier.
EV_WARDEN_INSPECTION_C3_O1: The nearest cutter opens fire as you burn for the gap.
EV_ASH_HUNTERS: The Ashmarket has put a price on your Ember. The hunter waiting at this beacon has the warrant painted on its hull, and reads your name out over every channel.
EV_ASH_HUNTERS_C1_O1: It has been paid half up front. It means to earn the rest.
EV_ASH_HUNTERS_C2_O1: Fifteen scrap and a lot of paperwork, and the market tears your name out of the ledger.
EV_ASH_INSIDER: An Ashmarket broker flashes you a friend-light from a hidden dock. Friends of the market, she says, pay friends' prices.
EV_ASH_INSIDER_C1_O1: She opens the back room, where the good stock is.
EV_ASH_INSIDER_C2_O1: She tells you which lanes the Hush took last week, then opens the stalls.
EV_ASH_INSIDER_C3_O1: She shrugs. There will be other friends.
EV_CHOIR_PROCESSION: A procession of Choir ships drifts past, slow and perfectly in step. They slow further to match you, and open their bays to your crew.
EV_CHOIR_PROCESSION_C1_O1: Your crew come back rested and humming a tune none of them can name.
EV_CHOIR_PROCESSION_C2_O1: The procession sings your Light into its song, and the song covers your trail.
EV_CHOIR_PROCESSION_C3_O1: The procession drifts on without a sound.
EV_CHOIR_QUIET: The Choir has stopped singing to you. In their silence the Ember burns lower, as if something far off is drinking from it.
EV_CHOIR_QUIET_C1_O1: The Ember holds, but the dark gains on you while it struggles.
EV_CHOIR_QUIET_C2: Have your stoker sing an apology.
EV_CHOIR_QUIET_C2_O1: The note carries. Far away, one voice of the Choir picks it up.
EV_CHOIR_QUIET_C2_O2: The note falls flat in the silence. The cold gets into the crew.
EV_ION_SQUALL: A squall of charged dust rolls across the lane, lit from inside by blue lightning. Through it is a clean jump. Around it is a long way.
EV_ION_SQUALL_C1_O1: Your pilot threads the lightning. You come out the far side ahead of the dark.
EV_ION_SQUALL_C1_O2: The squall throws you about like a toy. You come out the far side with scorched plating.
EV_ION_SQUALL_C2_O1: The long way is quiet and slow. Behind you, the Hush keeps coming.
EV_JAMMED_POD: A sealed cargo pod drifts at the beacon. Its hatch is jammed, and the label says FRAGILE in four languages.
EV_JAMMED_POD_C1_O1: The hatch gives with a sigh. Inside, packed in foam: rivets, plate, and a good wrench.
EV_JAMMED_POD_C1_O2: The hatch gives all at once and so does whatever was fragile. A little scrap survives.
EV_JAMMED_POD_C2_O1: Whatever is fragile stays that way.
EV_MINE_FIELD: The beacon is seeded with old mines, and a raider waits behind them for you to pick your way through.
EV_MINE_FIELD_C1_O1: Your gunner sets off a chain of mines right under the raider's nose.
EV_MINE_FIELD_C1_O2: The mines go off too close. You come through scorched, and the raider is waiting.
EV_MINE_FIELD_C2_O1: You slip through the field and out the far side. The raider will not follow you in.
EV_MINE_FIELD_C2_O2: A mine kisses the hull halfway through. The raider comes in after the blast.
EV_WARD_TRIAL: A Tidewarden training buoy challenges every ship that passes: hold your wards against its practice fire, and it pays out like a real fight.
EV_WARD_TRIAL_C1_O1: Your wards hold every volley. The buoy pays out, and logs your ship with the wardens.
EV_WARD_TRIAL_C1_O2: Practice fire, it turns out, still dents hull.
EV_WARD_TRIAL_C2_O1: The buoy flashes CHICKEN at you in three colors.
EV_STARVING_HEARTH: A tiny lamp station's hearth is guttering. Its keeper, in faded Tidewarden blue, begs for anyone who knows how to coax a dying flame.
EV_STARVING_HEARTH_C1_O1: The flame takes. The keeper presses a grain of Light into your stoker's hands.
EV_STARVING_HEARTH_C1_O2: The flame dies under your stoker's hands, and the cold gets into everyone.
EV_STARVING_HEARTH_C2_O1: The hearth roars back. The keeper will tell every warden she meets.
EV_STARVING_HEARTH_C3_O1: You leave her blowing on the coals.
EV_RUNAWAY_SLED: A raider is chasing a runaway cargo sled across the beacon. Whoever gets to the sled first keeps it, and the raider means to make that a fight.
EV_RUNAWAY_SLED_C1_O1: You snatch the sled from under its nose and turn to fight with full holds.
EV_RUNAWAY_SLED_C1_O2: It gets there first and turns its guns on you.
EV_RUNAWAY_SLED_C2_O1: Win this, and the sled is yours.
EV_CRACKED_CORE: A derelict lamp-ship's core is cracked but still warm. Someone steady could seal it and carry the Light out. Someone unsteady could set it off.
EV_CRACKED_CORE_C1: Seal it and take the Light.
EV_CRACKED_CORE_C1_O1: The seal holds. You carry the Light out in your arms like something sleeping.
EV_CRACKED_CORE_C1_O2: The crack spreads. You get clear before it blows, but not far enough.
EV_CRACKED_CORE_C2: Let your Keen mender do it.
EV_CRACKED_CORE_C2_O1: No drama at all. Two Light, sealed and bottled.
EV_CRACKED_CORE_C3_O1: You leave it ticking in the dark.
EV_TIDE_DOCK: A Tidewarden dry-dock sits under a single low lamp. The quartermaster checks your colors before she checks your scrap.
EV_TIDE_DOCK_C1_O1: She opens the ledger and names her prices.
EV_TIDE_DOCK_C2_O1: You leave the dock to its lamp.
EV_CHOIR_RELIQUARY: A Choir reliquary ship trades in silence. Its prices are sung, not spoken, and the tune changes with how the Choir feels about you.
EV_CHOIR_RELIQUARY_C1_O1: A low hymn rolls out of the bay doors. Somehow you understand every number in it.
EV_CHOIR_RELIQUARY_C2_O1: The hymn follows you to the edge of the beacon.
EV_ASH_SCRAPYARD: An Ashmarket scrapyard spins at the beacon, stacked with stripped hulls. The yard boss grins at your plating like it is already hers.
EV_ASH_SCRAPYARD_C1_O1: The yard boss opens the price board, still grinning.
EV_ASH_SCRAPYARD_C2: Lend her your crew for a shift.
EV_ASH_SCRAPYARD_C2_O1: Your crew come back sore and black with ash, with nine scrap of pay. Then she opens the board.
EV_ASH_SCRAPYARD_C3_O1: You cast off with all your plate still on.
EV_SEALED_CRATE: An Ashmarket courier wants you to carry a sealed crate through Tidewarden lanes. Good pay, no questions, and especially none from Tidewardens.
EV_SEALED_CRATE_C1_O1: The crate hums all the way through the lanes. The courier pays on time.
EV_SEALED_CRATE_C2: Report the courier to the wardens.
EV_SEALED_CRATE_C2_O1: The wardens thank you. The courier, on an open channel, does not.
EV_SEALED_CRATE_C3_O1: The courier shrugs and goes looking for someone hungrier.
EV_LAMP_CENSUS: A Tidewarden census buoy asks every passing ship to report the Choir beacons it has seen. The Choir, the buoy adds, need not know.
EV_LAMP_CENSUS_C1_O1: The buoy pays a small fee for every beacon. Somewhere, a hymn falters.
EV_LAMP_CENSUS_C2_O1: The buoy blinks at you, waiting, then gives up.
REP_BEATEN_TIDEWARDEN: The Tidewardens will remember this. The Ashmarket approves.
REP_BEATEN_ASHMARKET: The Ashmarket marks your name. The Tidewardens approve.
REP_BEATEN_CHOIR: The Hollow Choir goes quiet when you pass.
SIEGE_KINDLING_INTRO: The Cradle. Hold the Hush off until the Ember kindles it.
SIEGE_PHASE_TENDRILS_HINT: A knot gathers each wave. Shoot it, or ward the deck it strikes.
SIEGE_PHASE_SWALLOW_HINT: Waves now swallow a system. Ward it, break the knot, then mend.
SIEGE_PHASE_KINDLING_HINT: Burn Light to kindle the Cradle. Keep the Ember whole.
UI_KINDLED: The Cradle burns. The Hush falls back.
WPN_RIVET_GUN_DESC: Two cheap rivets a volley. Each hit strips a ward layer, so it opens the way for other guns.
WPN_HEAVY_RIVET_DESC: One heavy slug. It strips a ward layer and hits systems hard.
WPN_TORCH_LANCE_DESC: A burning beam. Wards stop it, but on bare hull it often starts a fire and burns crew.
WPN_KILN_BRAND_DESC: A quick firebrand. Wards stop it. Cheap power, good odds of a fire.
WPN_FROST_NEEDLE_DESC: Slips through wards. It does no hull damage: it freezes the crew in the room it hits.
WPN_RIME_LANCE_DESC: A deep freeze through any ward. Crew it hits go stiff and slow.
MOD_WICK_BELLOWS_DESC: Bellows that feed the Ember. More power for your systems, but it drinks Light every jump.
MOD_TALLOW_BAFFLES_DESC: Your wards rebuild their layers faster. The baffles soak up the ship's warmth.
MOD_GYRE_VANES_DESC: Spinning vanes that throw off enemy aim, so more shots miss.
MOD_RIVET_HOPPER_DESC: Feeds your guns so they charge faster. The hopper runs cold.
MOD_SALVAGE_MAW_DESC: Swallows more scrap after each fight won. Heavy, so the ship dodges less.
MOD_SLAG_PLATING_DESC: Extra hull plate: more hull to lose. Heavy, so the ship dodges less.
MOD_KILN_COILS_DESC: Coils that keep the rooms warm and soften Chill hits on your crew.
MOD_MENDER_LATTICE_DESC: The Mend room heals crew faster.
MOD_QUICKSTEP_RAILS_DESC: Crew run between rooms faster. The rails leak warmth.
MOD_LAMP_SIPHON_DESC: Draws Light out of every fight you win. The Hush follows faster.
MOD_HUSH_VEIL_DESC: Wraps the ship in stillness so enemy shots miss. It burns Light every jump.
SYS_EMBER_DESC: The Ember is your reactor and your heat. Stoking it gives one more power to share out.
SYS_WARDS_DESC: Shield layers over one deck. Every 2 power holds one layer.
SYS_WEAPONS_DESC: Power for your guns. A gun charges only while it has its power.
SYS_HELM_DESC: Dodge. Each power adds 5 dodge while someone is at the helm.
SYS_ENGINES_DESC: Dodge. Each power adds 5 more, on top of the helm's.
SYS_MEND_DESC: Heals crew who stand in the Mend room. More power heals faster.
UI_STORE_REPAIR_DESC: The dock crew patch the hull. When hull runs out, the run ends.
UI_STORE_LIGHT_DESC: Bottled Light. Each jump burns 1. Jumping with none cracks the hull.
UI_CARD_PROMPT: Tap anything to see what it does.
UI_CARD_UNFIT: Tap again to move it to the hold
UI_CARD_SELL: Tap again to sell for %d scrap
UI_CARD_NO_ROOM: No free slot and the hold is full
UI_CARD_NO_SLOT: No free slot to fit it in
